title: Bulgur and Vine Leaf Bake
subtitle: with green almonds and caramelised lemon
description: A quick take on stuffed vine leaves. Coarse bulgur, chopped fresh vine leaves and green almonds are baked in a pot over a layer of tomato and onion, topped with lemon slices.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C and grease the base of a casserole dish with olive oil.
Line the base of the dish with sliced tomatoes, brush with olive oil and top with a layer of sliced red onion.
In a bowl, mix the bulgur (soaked in cold water for 1-2 hours and drained), chopped vine leaves, green almonds and the rest of the olive oil, and season with turmeric, salt and pepper.
Spread the bulgur mixture in the dish and level it. Arrange sliced lemons on top, cover and bake for about 1 hour. Remove the lid and bake for another 15 minutes until browned.
